question: With functional shared-S LISTA semantics and stable recurrence optimization, do two or three learned refinements give better Allen--Cahn deployment forecasting?

failed_predecessor.result: All four forecast runs diverged under the generic 3e-4 S learning rate; no external panels were evaluated and no depth was selected.
failed_predecessor.repair: Freeze zero-initialized S during reconstruction pretraining and optimize S at 1e-5 only during forecast training. Architecture, losses, data, and all other learning rates remain fixed.

arms.pairing: Refinement count is the only factor changed between the four production fits.

semantics.counting_rule: lista_num_loops is the number of learned applications of S after initialization
semantics.gradient_gate: Each positive refinement count produces nonzero lista_s gradients in unit tests.

optimization.reason: The failed predecessor localized instability to repeated S after 2000 pretraining updates at the generic encoder rate. The repair isolates S without changing the forward model or forecast objective.

requirements: all three depths reach forecast step 500
minimum exact near-zero ratio at |z|<=1e-4 is >= 0.01
Q=0 leaves S exactly zero; Q=2 and Q=3 move S above numerical noise
each learned-refinement arm has a forecast checkpoint that improves on pretraining

training.checkpoint_metric: joint endpoints H160 and H200 on the even internal partition

evaluation.primary: direct repeated-K H200 cumulative field MSE on the three opened V5 validation panels
evaluation.secondary: terminal MSE and fixed periodic cadences 1,2,5,10,20,25,50,100
evaluation.depth_selector: Choose lower mean direct H200 cumulative MSE; within 1% relative prefer two refinements.
evaluation.rejection_rule: Reject both depths if the retained checkpoint is pretraining-only, any complete rollout is nonfinite, or neither depth is competitive with the historical sparse direct validation row.
evaluation.scope: Development-only selection on opened panels; a paper claim requires newly generated outcome-quarantined confirmation panels and additional paired seeds.

hardware.gpu: one A100L for the paired depth smoke, then one A100L per production depth with two seeds concurrent
